username.title: VeSync Email
username.description: Email of your VeSync account (Etekcity / Levoit app)

timeZone.title: Time Zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone used for the VeSync API

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (s)
pollInterval.description: How often to refresh device state from the cloud (minimum 30)

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If the list is empty, all the devices will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Only for debugging.
